Select a row in a multi-record tape image and click **Play Record**. Playback starts at that record’s leader and stops at the end of the record. Choose **Select whole tape** to play the image sequentially again.

Download **MZT-Player-1.4.0-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the archive checksum. The build is ad hoc signed and not Apple-notarised.
